description: Creates a Meetful booking page (meetful.com/<handle>) and returns the code to put it on a website: a one-line button, the page inline, an iframe, or a plain link. Every booking gets its own video room. For a signed-in person the page is theirs and live at once; otherwise the result includes a claim link, and the page goes live when its owner signs in.

blurb.description: A sentence or two under the heading.

email.description: The person's address — shown on the claim page so they know it was made for them. Nothing is sent to it.

handle.description: The address wanted: meetful.com/<handle>. Optional — one is made from the name.

hours.description: Open hours, like "Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00" or "Mon-Thu 9am-5pm; Fri 9am-1pm". Default Monday to Friday, 9 to 5.

lengths.description: How long a meeting can be, in minutes — any of 15, 30, 45, 60, 90. The person booking picks one; the first is shown first. Default 30.

name.description: Whose booking page this is — shown on it.

site.description: The website it goes on — shown to the person when they claim it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the hours are in, like America/New_York.

title.description: The page's heading, like "Book a call with Ada".

name: set_up_booking_page
title: Set up a booking page
